text:
Aisha: Kickoff — starting a 4-week sprint to integrate the edge orchestrator + gateway adapters with LangChain and LlamaIndex. Primary deliverables: marketplace listing draft, sample SDK adapter, and a joint partner announcement plan. Goal: coordinated launch in 6 weeks.
Liam: Are we targeting the new gateway v2 contract or maintaining compat for v1?
Aisha: @Liam prefer v2 for long-term but we need v1 fallbacks for existing SI demos. Make adapter toggles.
Marta: I'll own the sample app + smoke tests. Quick ask: what runtimes should the sample cover? Hosted, Dedicated, Private?
Ken: All three. Marketing wants a clear matrix in the announcement: hosted demo + dedicated perf numbers + private deployment checklist.
Sigrid (Sigrid Systems): On the HW side we can validate the adapter on our A2 nodes next week. Need a short test harness and an image.
Liam: Perfect. I'll sketch the gateway shim and version toggle. Quick mock of the adapter config:
```
adapter:
  name: redwood-gateway-shim
  langchain_compat: true
  lindex_compat: true
  fallback: true
  hw_profile: sigrid-a2
```
Marta: Thx — I'll wire that into the sample app. Plan to run nightly smoke on PRs.
Aisha: Coordination notes:
- Owners: Marta (sample app/tests), Liam (adapter + contract), Ken (announce + marketplace copy), Aisha (partner sync + roadmap)
- Blockers: signing/access for Sigrid infra, gateway v2 spec finalization, marketplace legal checklist.
Ken: For the announcement cadence, propose: partner preview (partners-only) -> private beta -> public blog + marketplace listing. Need comms timeline by EOW.
Sigrid (Sigrid Systems): We'll give infra access by Tue. Also happy to provide a short quote for the joint blog.
Liam: I'll open PRs for adapter skeleton tomorrow and add feature flags for v1/v2.
Marta: Creating the test matrix doc now. Will include perf targets: 95th latency < 200ms on Dedicated, embedding throughput target X.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: nightly/smoke for branch 'edge-orch-gateway-integration' queued (expected duration ~45m).
Aisha: Nice — next sync Thursday 10am PT. Agenda: infra access status, adapter PR review, marketplace content draft. Please add blockers to the thread. :thumbsup:
